data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Renos', meaning 'rejoicing'. In Christian tradition, the name Renell is associated with deep faith and devotion to God. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Renell usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
